gloss: person who likes to help others; meddlesome person

definitions.gloss: person who likes to help others; someone who enjoys taking care of others
definitions.explanation: a person who naturally tends to help and take care of people around them
someone who interferes in others' affairs, often unwanted (negative nuance)

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{世話好|せわず}きで{頼|たよ}りになる。
examples.english: She likes helping others and is dependable.

examples.japanese: {世話好|せわず}きな{性格|せいかく}で、{困|こま}っている{人|ひと}を{見|み}ると{放|ほう}っておけない。
examples.english: Having a helpful nature, I can't leave someone in trouble alone.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{世話好|せわず}きで、いつも{近所|きんじょ}の{子供|こども}の{面倒|めんどう}を{見|み}ている。
examples.english: My grandmother likes to help out and always looks after the neighborhood children.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世話好|せわず}きで{余計|よけい}なお{節介|せっかい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: He's meddlesome and often gives unwanted help.

examples.japanese: {世話好|せわず}きも{度|ど}を{過|す}ぎると{迷惑|めいわく}になる。
examples.english: Being overly helpful can become a nuisance.

examples.japanese: {世話好|せわず}きな{人|ひと}は{良|よ}くも{悪|わる}くも{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: People who like to help stand out, for better or worse.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{世話|せわ} (care/help) + {好|ず}き (liking/fond of)

USAGE:
Can be positive (caring, helpful) or negative (meddlesome, nosy) depending on context. When excessive, it can be seen as お{節介|せっかい} (unsolicited interference).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a noun or a na-adjective:
- {世話好|せわず}きな{人|ひと} - a helpful/meddlesome person
- {世話好|せわず}きである - to like helping others

SIMILAR ～{好|ず}き COMPOUNDS:
- {甘党|あまとう}/{辛党|からとう} - person who likes sweets/spicy food
- お{人好|ひとよ}し - good-natured person
- {面倒|めんどう}{見|み}がいい - takes good care of others
